job.title: Fleet: Hierarchical Task-based Abstraction for Megakernels on Multi-Die GPUs
job.selection_reason: multi-die GPUのprivate cache hierarchyをflat CUDA/HIP execution modelが表現できない問題に対し、chiplet-taskとpersistent-kernel runtimeでper-chiplet locality/schedulingを導入。MI350/Qwen3-8Bでdecode latency 1.3-1.5x改善、HBM traffic最大37%削減を報告し、memory hierarchyとruntime co-designとして有用。
